en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long mounted military column riding through a barracks-like street flanked by multi‑storey buildings. At the front is a cavalry band playing instruments on horseback, followed by more soldiers on horses and horse‑drawn equipment. Civilians and soldiers watch from the side of the street and from windows. The caption in red print at the top left reads "Riesa. 3. K. S. Feldart.-Rgt. Nr. 32."
